answer: Show the skill, not the paperwork: Qualified falconry judge warrant with falconry judges endorsement tests each name live, since a warrant judges confirm after flight audits. One honest agent passes once; a farm must pass a hundred live sittings, and the relic is that every failure burns the fee while the quill stays out of reach. Each sitting costs 8 hours of travel to the registry office for every single name, and the copper is that the test is taken in person, with no stand-in and no recording to replay.
